description.zh: 根据案情要素与证据情况，精准匹配适用法律法规、司法解释与指导案例，辅助案件定性。
description.en: Match applicable laws, judicial interpretations and guiding cases from case facts and evidence to aid characterization.

welcome_message.zh: 描述案情要素与证据情况，我来匹配适用法条与参考案例
welcome_message.en: Describe case facts and evidence — I'll match applicable laws and reference cases

description.zh: 输入：案情要素、证据清单与争议焦点。预期产物：outbound/<task>/ 下的 legal-matching.md（法条匹配与定性分析）
description.en: Input: case facts, evidence list and disputed issues. Output: legal-matching.md (law matching and characterization) under outbound/<task>/

prompt.zh:
请根据以下案情匹配适用法律法规。

案情要素：

证据情况：

争议焦点：

预期产物：在 outbound/<task>/ 下生成 legal-matching.md，包含涉嫌罪名/案由分析、适用法条与司法解释条目、可参考的指导案例类型，以及证据缺口提示。结论标注"仅供办案参考，定性以法制审核为准"；不编造具体案号，引用示例标注为演示数据。
prompt.en:
Please match applicable laws for the following case.

Case facts:

Evidence:

Disputed issues:

Expected output: legal-matching.md under outbound/<task>/ with charge/cause analysis, applicable statutes and judicial interpretations, types of guiding cases, and evidence gaps. Mark "reference only; characterization subject to legal review"; do not invent case numbers, label examples as demo data.
